title: Backtracking Pattern
intuition: Build candidate solutions incrementally and reject paths dynamically when they fail constraint verification.
step_by_step_strategy: If current state is a valid complete solution, record it.
If choice is valid, apply choice.
common_mistakes: Failing to undo choice step before returning
Missing boundary constraint checking before recursion
content: Build candidate solutions incrementally and reject paths dynamically when they fail constraint verification.
